name: GS-PowerFlow-100 — Procedural Text
protocol: GS-PowerFlow fixed 100-case replication, procedural-text prompt, no tools, one run per case, strict <5% relative-error success.

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of 100 cases whose first parsed requested power value has relative error below 5%.
explanation.zh: 分数是 100 个案例中，首次解析出的目标功率值相对误差低于 5% 的比例。

summary.en: GS-PowerFlow-100 tests manual numerical power-flow reasoning on three-bus AC systems.
summary.zh: GS-PowerFlow-100 测试模型在三节点交流系统上手工进行数值潮流计算的能力。

task_format.en: Without tools, the model follows a Gauss–Seidel procedure and reports converged slack-bus real or reactive power for 100 cases.
task_format.zh: 模型不使用工具，按 Gauss–Seidel 过程求解 100 个案例，并输出收敛后的平衡节点有功或无功功率。
